user.title: Connect to poschodoch.sk
user.description: Open https://www.poschodoch.sk, sign in, then in DevTools go to Application → Local Storage → www.poschodoch.sk and copy the values of both the `id_token` and `id_refresh_token` keys, pasted below. Both are needed together — the refresh call requires the current access token paired with its refresh token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate poschodoch.sk
reauth_confirm.description: Your poschodoch.sk session has expired or was revoked. Repeat the same steps to get a fresh pair of tokens from your browser's local storage.

error.invalid_auth: That token pair was rejected. Make sure you copied both values correctly, freshly, and that you're still signed in on poschodoch.sk.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach poschodoch.sk. Check your connection and try again.
